visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a group of six individuals walking in a synchronized line along a paved stone path next to a clear blue swimming pool at dusk. The leader, a young man with dyed blonde hair, wears a red sash with white text and red shorts over a black patterned long-sleeve shirt, marching with exaggerated high steps and a focused facial expression. Behind him follow three men and two women in casual summer and athletic attire, including tank tops and shorts, walking with a playful rhythm. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where the group stops in a line; the leader with the red sash faces the camera, speaking energetically with wide hand gestures while others listen with various expressions. A close-up of a Coca-Cola Zero Sugar bottle appears as it is opened, with festive gold and silver paper confetti bursting around the group as they raise their arms in a celebratory cheer by the poolside under a cloudy, orange-tinted sky. (3) Detailed close-up shots focus on a glass being prepared on a table: large, clear ice cubes are poured into a branded Coca-Cola glass, followed by a slice of lemon placed carefully with metal tongs. Dark carbonated liquid is poured from a bottle at a forty-five-degree angle, creating a rich foamy head and visible bubbles. The lighting is bright and cinematic, emphasizing the texture of the ice and the condensation on the glass. (4) Multiple rapid cuts show the group members diving and jumping into the swimming pool, creating large white water splashes. The leader is shown chest-deep in the water, holding a Coke bottle high with an enthusiastic smile. The visual focus shifts to a BBQ setting, showing raw meat sizzling on a charcoal grill and a large table spread featuring platters of grilled beef, shrimp, corn, bell peppers, and numerous bottles of Coca-Cola arranged as a center piece. (5) Characters are shown eating the grilled food and drinking from glasses with satisfied, joyful expressions. The entire group gathers for a final pose at the edge of the pool, holding their drinks and food plates towards the camera. Finally, the scene transitions to a supermarket interior where the main character, now wearing a red-and-white striped t-shirt, stands in front of a meat display shelf holding a package of pork and two large Coke bottles, speaking directly to the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-tempo, rhythmic electronic beat featuring a prominent 4/4 kick drum and bright, staccato synthesizer stabs. A male voice delivers a punchy "One, two" rhythmic count in a high-pitched, energetic tone, synchronized with the heavy percussive sound of marching footsteps. The spectral brightness is elevated, emphasizing the crisp transients of the production. (2) A sharp transition Whoosh sound effect leads into a dense layer of collective human cheering, shouting, and laughter, exhibiting high vocal arousal and positive emotional valence. The background music swells, maintaining its driving tempo. The primary speaker's voice becomes more projected and dramatic, layered with synthesized comic sound effects that punctuate the high-energy party atmosphere. (3) High-fidelity foley effects take center stage: the crisp mechanical sound of a bottle cap opening, the sharp percussive clinking of ice cubes against glass, and the detailed bubbling sound of a carbonated liquid being poured. These acoustic events have a high signal-to-noise ratio and momentarily duck the music to highlight the sensory texture of the beverage. (4) Large broadband splash sounds signify movement into water, accompanied by multiple high-arousal vocal exclamations from a group. The music continues with a catchy melodic jingle featuring a male singer. Sizzling high-frequency noise textures represent the BBQ grill, interspersed with rhythmic chewing and exaggerated "Ah!" vocalizations from the cast. (5) The final phase features a direct address from the main speaker in a slightly more narrative but still high-energy tone. His articulation is clear and professional, with moderate speech density. The music remains a constant bed, culminating in a final percussive Pop and a synthesized digital stinger. The overall track is highly compressed for consistent broadcast loudness.
